name: anvisio-data
description: Anvisio CDN-served prompts, manifests, widget libraries, and schemas. Root scripts mirror CI gates so authors can validate before pushing.

scripts.validate: GITHUB_BASE_REF=${GITHUB_BASE_REF:-main} node tools-build/ci/check-frontmatter.mjs && node tools-build/ci/check-schema.mjs && node tools-build/ci/check-version-bump.mjs && node tools-build/ci/check-cross-refs.mjs && node tools-build/ci/check-license.mjs && node tools-build/ci/check-pii.mjs && node tools-build/ci/check-size.mjs
scripts.validate:all: node tools-build/ci/check-frontmatter.mjs --all && node tools-build/ci/check-schema.mjs --all && node tools-build/ci/check-cross-refs.mjs && node tools-build/ci/check-license.mjs && node tools-build/ci/check-pii.mjs && node tools-build/ci/check-size.mjs
